2609.40290.title: CAS II: Orbits as Models: Kolmogorov's Structure Function under Symmetry
2609.40290.paper_summary:
In algorithmic statistics a string x is explained by a finite set containing it, and Kolmogorov's structure function records the smallest such model at each level of complexity. Strong models, those computable from the data by a total algorithm, are essentially the cells of simple partitions, so a partition of {0,1}^n can be read as a hypothesis and the cell containing x as the model it assigns. We develop algorithmic statistics over symmetric partitions, the orbit partitions of groups acting on strings.
  The Galois connection between subgroups and partitions gives each ambient group G a lattice of symmetric partitions with canonical certificates, joins and meets. A set is a cell of a symmetric partition exactly when its setwise stabiliser in G acts transitively on it, so the resulting structure function is Kolmogorov's restricted to these G-homogeneous sets. With a symmetric sophistication, it measures which part of the regularity of x is symmetric.
  Under the full symmetric group, cells recover all models and cells of cheap partitions recover exactly the strong models, so normal and strange strings are characterised by symmetry. For GL(n,2) the homogeneous sets are the linearly homogeneous ones, whose XOR dependencies look the same from every point. The GL structure function of a nonzero x lies in a band between C(x) - alpha and n - alpha, and both edges are attained: some stochastic normal strings have simple structure invisible to linear symmetry, with sophistication near 0 but GL-sophistication near C(x).
  We coordinatise permutation groups by a Burnside ring element (type) and a permutation (placement). In these coordinates a linear hypothesis is determined by its type up to n^2 bits, and any space of symmetry hypotheses small enough to search is small enough to miss simple structure. This sets up learned search over orbit models, the subject of later papers in the series.
2609.40290.paper_summary_zh:
在算法統計中，一個字串 x 是由包含它的有限集合所解釋的，而 Kolmogorov 的結構函數記錄了每個複雜度層級下最小的這種模型。強模型，即由總算法從數據中計算出的模型，本質上是簡單劃分的單元，因此 {0,1}^n 的劃分可以被視為一個假設，而包含 x 的單元則是它所指派的模型。我們在對稱劃分上發展算法統計，這是作用於字串的群的軌道劃分。  
子群和劃分之間的 Galois 連接為每個環境群 G 提供了一個帶有典範證明的對稱劃分格，包含聯接和交集。當且僅當其在 G 中的集合穩定子群對其作用是傳遞的時候，一個集合才是對稱劃分的單元，因此得到的結構函數是 Kolmogorov 限制於這些 G-均勻集合。通過對稱的複雜性，它測量 x 的規則性中哪一部分是對稱的。  
在完全對稱群下，單元恢復所有模型，而便宜劃分的單元則恰好恢復強模型，因此正常和奇異字串的特徵由對稱性決定。對於 GL(n,2)，均勻集合是線性均勻的，這些集合的 XOR 依賴性從每個點看起來都是一樣的。非零 x 的 GL 結構函數位於 C(x) - alpha 和 n - alpha 之間的帶中，且兩個邊界都是可達的：一些隨機正常字串具有對線性對稱性不可見的簡單結構，複雜性接近 0，但 GL-複雜性接近 C(x)。  
我們通過一個 Burnside 環元素（類型）和一個置換（位置）來協調置換群。在這些坐標中，線性假設由其類型決定，最多 n^2 位，任何足夠小的對稱假設空間都足夠小以至於錯過簡單結構。這為對軌道模型的學習搜索奠定了基礎，這是系列後續論文的主題。
2609.40290.author: Romie Banerjee et.al.
